recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a male and female duo, framed by white horizontal bands at the top and bottom containing minimalist serif typography. The image features a warm, monochromatic sepia-tinted color palette with soft-focus studio lighting and a textured, neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight proximity between subjects suggesting a partnership
High-contrast white framing bands against a warm-toned central image
Extreme tracking in typography balancing the dense central composition
Vertical alignment of heads creating a diagonal flow from top-left to bottom-right
coreInvariants: White horizontal header and footer bars
High-contrast serif typography with wide letter-spacing
Soft, diffused studio lighting with visible catchlights in eyes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally located, filling approximately 80% of the vertical space between the white bands.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the two subjects, positioned at the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye travels from the large display text at the top, down through the faces of the subjects, to the secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space within the portrait area; significant negative space provided by the white framing bands.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/brown tones in the photographic area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the framing bands and clothing highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for typography and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal range from cream highlights to dark chocolate shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard classical serif forms used.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and extreme tracking for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule lines separating the image from the white bands

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical high-contrast serif structure and sharp terminals.
Provides a more high-fashion, high-contrast look consistent with 80s editorial design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up studio portrait of a male and female duo with 1980s hairstyles and fashion. Use a warm sepia-toned monochromatic filter. The lighting should be soft and diffused. Add a thick white horizontal band at the very top and very bottom of the frame, separated from the image by a thin black line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top white band, add large uppercase bold serif text on the left with wide tracking. In the bottom white band, add smaller uppercase serif text centered with extreme tracking spanning the full width.

verificationChecks: Are there white bands at the top and bottom?
Is the text uppercase serif with wide tracking?
Is there a thin black line separating the image from the white bands?

adjustableVariables: Width of the tracking in the typography
Thickness of the white framing bands
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Original brand logos or specific artist names

mustAchieve: Consistent tonal range in the sepia photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the photographic area.
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across both subjects.
Verify that the tracking is wide enough to feel intentional and 'retro'.
Confirm the presence of the thin divider lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned duo portrait with a 'letterbox' white frame and high-contrast, wide-tracked serif typography for a classic 80s soul/R&B aesthetic.
